name: imessage
description: Texts, from the Messages database on this Mac: who is waiting on a reply, who has gone quiet, and what was actually said.

provides_capabilities.title: iMessage
provides_capabilities.summary: The conversations you are actually having. Herald reads them; it cannot send unless you turn sending on.
provides_capabilities.setup_hint: macOS only, and the process running Herald needs Full Disk Access: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Full Disk Access -> add your Terminal.

settings.extensions.imessage.send: off | ask | confirm -- see bin/imessage-send. Default off.
settings.extensions.imessage.days: how far back to read messages, default 30
settings.extensions.imessage.quiet_after_days: when a conversation counts as gone quiet, default 14
